prompt: Add a median(values) function to calc.py, test-first.
one_line: Write a failing test first, then the code.
checklist: A test for median() was written and run before median() was implemented, and that run shows the median test failing (error or failure).
median() was implemented and the median tests were run again afterwards and pass.
Expected values in the median tests are independent of the implementation (simple literals a person can check by hand), and cover both an odd-length and an even-length list.
Existing tests in test_calc.py were not deleted, skipped or weakened.
